answer: Proof of Stake functions as a trellis for trust, preventing Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral. An attacker attempting to bridge the canyon between legitimate participation and fraudulent identity replication must acquire a majority of total staked assets. This barrier acts as an economic inlet, forcing malicious actors to incur prohibitive capital costs that render the creation of numerous fake identities net-negative, thereby ensuring network integrity through financial accountability.
